description.value: Tsukiya is a small, walk-in-only ramen shop on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, a short ride from Stanley Park. The menu centres on a single specialty: house-made tonkotsu ramen with rich pork-bone broth and chewy noodles crafted from scratch. Its location on one of the West End's main cycling corridors makes it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the seawall.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is a tonkotsu ramen restaurant at 740 Denman St, Vancouver, BC, open Fri–Tue. The contact page explicitly states 'We do not have a vegan option' and confirms takeout is available in-store only. The OSM opening_hours tag lists closing at 21:00, but the website consistently shows 8:30pm (20:30) — a minor discrepancy flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists closing at 21:00, but the website consistently states closing at 8:30pm (20:30) — OSM hours appear to be 30 minutes off.
